candidates.reason: Aggregates by exact pickup timestamp first, then combines hour totals. The cast preserves COUNT(*)'s BIGINT type, including the NULL-hour group.
candidates.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1

candidates.reason: Uses window counting and DISTINCT to return one row per hour, preserving NULL grouping and BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Uses filtered aggregation and HAVING to retain exactly the routes with qualifying rows, preserving duplicate counts, NULL route keys, and the original day predicate.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0

candidates.reason: Filters with the original calendar-day predicate, then uses window counting and DISTINCT to preserve route groups and BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
